profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m an enthusiastic, highly motivated IT professional who believes that by teaching good development practices like version control, incremental changes, and doing daily builds we can deliver quality applications faster. And by working with infrastructure teams to create repeatable processes for deployment we can decrease deployment time, decrease human errors (the deadly fat finger), and free up time to solve bigger problems. Bridging the gap between development and operations will ultimately bring success.

Throughout my career I collaborated with development teams to understand their manual build process and to create a continuous build pipeline using Jenkins, Maven, and Ant. Then I moved on to work with infrastructure engineers to script automated deployments to various Jboss middleware products. Currently my interests are in learning Puppet to do automated provisioning and Ansible for deployments and configuration management. I'm always looking for new challenges and ways to further my career.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created and managed Amazon EKS clusters and plain old Kubeadm clusters in Azure
- Used terraform to stand up AWS resources
- Developed multiple kubernetes controllers and custom resource definitions (CRDS) to support custom platform features. Ask me what my favorite controllers are
- Implemented a pod horizontal autoscaling solution with development teams by understanding application scaling triggers, unique requirements
- Worked with security and compliance to understand FedRAMP requirements and installed Istio as a service mesh
- Advocated for tech debt prioritization, regular platform risk evaluations, and platform innovation 
- Managed legacy DC/OS platform and surrounding infrastructure such as Traefik, Nagios, Logstash clusters

positions.title: Platform Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead an agile platform engineering team as a “product owner”. Encouraged using kanban for everyday tasks and to stay organized as a team. Served as the point of intake from matrix teams, worked tasks into a backlog, and prioritized work in order support all nine development teams. 
- Architected container solutions with development teams by understanding applications’ designs, unique requirements, and communicated existing or enterprise blessed patterns
- Deploy and operationalized a production Docker swarm. Maintained and upgraded this infrastructure using Ansible. Built a CI/CD pattern for deploying Docker swarm secrets and stacks. Used Mashape Kong for route management and Gitlab-CI for deployment.
- Developed Terraform for deploying EKS clusters in AWS. Used Gitlab-CI for orchestrating cluster creation and installing helm charts for various tools to support Kubernetes like Prometheus, Grafana, Fluentd, Hashicorp Vault.

Contributed to Terraform for other AWS services such as ECS, RDS, and Elasticache

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with message broker development teams to deliver a continuous integration and automated deployment solution to IBM Integration bus using Jenkins, Ant, and IBM Urbancode Deploy
- Converted bash deployment scripts into Ansible playbook for deployments to Jboss middleware products to reduce the cost of Urbancode Deploy agents and ensure resiliency of deployments
- Developed scripts to perform daily manual administration tasks for Urbancode Deploy such as creating projects, components, resources in order to standardize the on boarding process for the tool
- Designed blue-green deployments for Jboss EAP deployments using Urbancode Deploy
- Developed Jboss fuse fabric deployment scripts using bash and Urbancode Deploy
- Administered various DevOps tools which included SVN, Jenkins, SonarQube, Nexus, Urbancode Deploy, Confluence

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Support Cigna's system management infrastructure including incident, change and problem resolution 
•	Examine application structure, configuration, and change history of business critical applications to improve application availability 
•	Provide analytics to configuration item owners to immediately isolate discovery errors in order to maintain server inventory and ensure successful application mapping
•	Create process in order to be more proactive in resolving discovery issues
